emails.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your message.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 94,800 units per year for 36 months, 284,400 units in total.
2. Our proposal: option A: EUR 4.73 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 45 days net, 36-month contract; option B: EUR 4.70 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 14 days net, 36-month contract; option C: EUR 4.78 per unit, no price-adjustment clause, 90 days net, 36-month contract. Option A amounts to about EUR 1,345,212 over the term.
3. Basis: On 2026-09-10 you quoted us EUR 5.45 per unit for this part; your new quote is 11.0% above it. Our demand forecast for this part is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09), and we commit 118,500 units a year.
4. Next step: Please send us your cost breakdown for this part. All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of one option we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
